releases.name: Version 1.3.0
releases.body:
- Replaced MenuFramework with calls to "new" OWML menu system.
- Fixed poses for holding items not working. No idea how long this has been broken...
- Rewrote the HUD that shows what planet each player is on.
  - Added compatibility with custom New Horizons planets. The HUD will use the sprite defined in `MapModeInfo.revealedSprite`. If no sprite is defined, it will use the default unknown icon (a question mark).
    - This should also work when base-game planets have their ship log icon overridden with a new one, but I haven't tested this since I don't think anyone has actually done this yet.
  - Added a new config option, `Always Show Planet Icons`, which is by default disabled. Normally, QSB will display a question mark when you are in places where you cannot usually open your map. By enabling this option, this behaviour does not happen. This means the exact planet you are on will always be visible, even if it doesn't fit thematically to know that information.
- Stop players from connecting if they have New Horizons installed and the server doesn't, or vice versa.
- Increased default timeout length from 25 seconds to 40 seconds. This should help with timeouts during long New Horizons load times.
- Made other players invisible in an ending sequence.
- Made player markers invisible in more locations.

releases.name: Version 6.0.0
releases.body:
- Added loco's gizmos support to release. I think they're still jank, so report any bugs you find.
- Allowed for Unity Explorer usage in the post credits scene (thanks to anon)
- **Switched over to Cinematic Unity Explorer. Please read the [guide](https://framedsc.com/GeneralGuides/cinematic-unity-explorer.htm#hotkeys) for all the cool new features this brings.** one of the things is better freecam and **camera paths**, which should be helpful for trailers.

- Changed default Hotkeys from:
  - "R" → "G"
  - "T" → "B"
- Added configuration for changing keys, but isn't implemented.

* Adds interactable gizmos 
    * To use them first select a transform with the scene inspector
    * Then press `R` to cycle from `Local Position`, `Local Rotation` and none.
    * You can even then press `T` to when...
         * in `Local Position` mode go from actual local position to using the transform orientation
         * in `Local Rotation` to toggle a rotation wheel that always looks at the camera
         
 * This used Unity Explorer version `4.9.0`
 * This is a pre-release, so if something goes terribly wrong please tell me.
idk download it and find out

# Changelog
* Added + and - buttons to the GameObject inspector's Transform controls for precision adjustments, along with an input field to set the increment value for said buttons and the slider.
* Implemented Control key modifier to the Home/End line jump in the C# Console (holding control will cause Home/End to jump to the start/end of the entire document).
# In UniverseLib
* Fixed an issue with IL2CPP games that use the new InputSystem
* Fixed certain IL2CPP IEnumerable and IDictionary types failing to enumerate
* Fixed a null reference that could occur in games which have no EventSystem
* Fixed a null reference when attempting to parse invalid user input

### Hotfix
- Fixed the standalone releases not initialising outside of the editor (https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/142)
- Fixed input remaining locked if all menus were closed while the "resizing arrow" was visible
- Changed the editor save data folder to the project root folder instead of the Assets folder
- Added some more rigorous checks to ensure all objects are cleaned up in the editor
- Fixed rare cases of panels not having valid sizes or positions after loading save data
### Changes
- C# Console: Implemented Home and End keys to jump to the start/end of the line
- Type auto-completers are now async, greatly increasing responsivity and reducing initial startup time
- IL2CPP Unhollowed module loading is now async, reducing delays during the startup process
- Fixed an issue when constructing a generic hook and then pressing the Edit button on an existing hook before finishing
- Fixed a Unity error that could occur when closing the UnityExplorer menu

## Bug fixes

- Log errors and prevent users from creating NHItems with the WarpCore type, as those must extend the WarpCoreItem class and should be done with custom code. #1121 
- Fixed an issue when reloading configs while having preloaded bundles. #1101 and #1130.

- Fixed the AWC in the Vessel vanishing sometimes when warping back from DB. Fixes #1057.
- Fix supernova scaling improperly depending on chosen speed. Fixes #1150.

## Documentation
- Recommended prefixing ship log fact/entry IDs and dialogue condition IDs with the name of your mod to prevent possible incompatibility issues. #1087
- Documented recommended cloak sizes (at least x6 the size of the planet) #1089

- Updated Chinese Translation (thanks @SanBaiMing)
- Added `QueryAddonManifest` to API and `extras` to addon manifest
- Added `gravityVolumeLayer` to `Base`
- Added `quantumToggleVolume` to `Volumes`. Toggles the ability for specified quantum objects to change their quantum state when entering the volume.

- `activationCondition` and `deactivationCondition` now check for persistent conditions too

- Fixed an issue where splash colours don't get initialized properly for other planets if you spawn on a planet with clouds/water

releases.name: Version 1.29.2
releases.body:
## Minor features

- Can now implement custom translatable alien languages. This is done on each arc by
setting `customTextImage` to an image path, `legiblePersistentCondition`
for learning the new language, and optionally `customLanguageName` to
give it a name.
- Can now override the color translation text for an arc with `overrideUnreadColor` and optionally `overrideTranslatedColor`
- Can now have a separate ship spawn point for warping into the system with the ship's warp drive with `warpDriveSpawnPointID` in system config. Resolves #1133
- Added `musicFadeInTime`, `musicVolume`, and `ambienceVolume` to title screen configs.
- Added `IsWarpingBackToEye`, `GetCenterOfStarSystem`, `GetPlayerSpawnPoint`, `GetShipSpawnPoint` to API.
- Added `showDescriptionNotAchieved` to achievement info and `DescriptionNotAchieved` to achievement translations.
- Added `campfires` to `Props`. Can set the state to be lit, smoldering, or unlit.
- Added `fuelTanks` to `Props`. Can change type to be the Hearthian tanks or DLC torchs.
- Added `alarmBells` to `Props`. Resolves #1118
- Added `alarmBellPath` to `dreamCampfires`.
- Added `playerRecoveryVolumes` to `Volumes`. Interacting can refuel or heal the player.
- Reveal volumes can now use different shapes.

## Improvements

- Moved `solarSystemVolume` to a better name `starSystemVolumes`.
- `IsWarpingBackToEye` now stops `OnCompleteSceneLoad` from running.
- Now logs if it fails to load your credits.

## Bug fixes

- Somewhat fix ghost birds having broken arms in mods like Examples and Granite's Invitation but Escape Room is still broken ahhhhh why why why why!!!!! Mobius why did you slightly adjust ghost birds in a patch!!!!! No it's okay you're allowed I forgive you.
- Translator tool no longer appears in dream world.
- Fix fonts for different languages on star chart mode. Fixes #1137
- Fix rich presence on quantum planets.
- Fix speed limiter volume exception.
- Fix credits button on title screen not working.
- Fix warping to the Outer Wilds killing you instantly.
- Fix DLC required popup not appearing for some DLC props. 

**Generated From PR: https://github.com/Outer-Wilds-New-Horizons/new-horizons/pull/1135**

## Bug fixes

releases.name: Version 1.29.0
releases.body:
## Major features

- Overhauled the visuals of New Horizons' interstellar mode in the ship
log! Additionally, if your ship is equipped with a warp drive functionally,
there will be a new visual 3D model representing the warp drive on your
ship! Thanks @lezzlebit for implementing this!
- Ability to specify a sector path for things to use, instead of just the planet's top-level sector. Can also automatically find the innermost sector

# Minor features

- Added `sectorPath` to most props to allow specifying a sector other
than the planet's root sector for the purposes of culling and other
sector behavior. The special value `"auto"` finds the first sector in
the prop's parent hierarchy.
- Particle fields
	- No more arbitrary particle limit (slightly breaks back compat since any too large input that was being capped now isn't, but that behavior was pointless and not worth preserving)
	- Override field radius

## Improvements

- Particle fields:
	- More depth in documentation
	- Default rain is now the correct higher density, and snow is equivalent without needing duplicates

## Bug fixes

- Added a security check to ScatterBuilder.
- CurrentStarSystem now prevents invalid values properly. Fixes #1128
- Stranger type translator texts are now colored properly. Fixes #1125
- Star ambient lights are no longer always orange. Fixes #1102

releases.name: Smol Hatchling 2.0: Outer Wilds Scale Manipulator
releases.body:
# Smol Hatchling 2.0: Outer Wilds Scale Manipulator
Smol Hatchling has been remade from the ground up! Smol Hatchling can now be used not only by players who want to experience Outer Wilds from many different scales, but by other mod developers who may want to resize the player or other things in their mods.

## Features

### Customizable Scale for the Player, Anglerfish, the Stranger's Inhabitants, and more!
With Smol Hatchling, you can set the player character to any size you want; smaller than a marshmallow, bigger than the solar system, or anywhere in between!

It even comes with hotkeys you can use to change your scale on the fly: press the "<" key to divide your size by two, ">" to multiply it by two, and "/" to return to normal. Player properties such as their collider size, grounded raycasts, and speed are automatically tweaked to work with the Player being resized.

Smol Hatchling can be used to resize **any object** in the game. All moving creatures will have their movement speed and other attributes adjusted as well so it makes sense compared to their size! I'm planning to add adjustments for other types of objects in the future so that they will also be fully functional at different sizes!

Note: Custom Player Scale must be enabled in the config menu prior to use. Otherwise, Smol Hatchling will automatically use the default player scale or the scale set by other mods.

### API for use by other Mods
Smol Hatchling comes with an API that other mods can use to resize the Player or other objects!

releases.name: v1.5.1: Scaled Player Attributes
releases.body:
- Replace "Height and Radius" settings with "Player Scale", which will change the player's scale on all axes, and "Width Factor", which will adjust how wide the character is compared to their normal width.
- The player's movement speed and jump height will now adjust based on their size (can be disabled).

releases.name: v1.5.0: Major Rewrite, Stool Viewmodel Arms with Immersion, Major Bugfix
releases.body:
- The stool item will now have a viewmodel arm if Immersion (Owen_013.FirstPersonPresence) is installed!
- The DLC is no longer required to avoid errors.
- Major behind-the-scenes refactoring.

releases.name: v1.4.0: Stools Full Release
releases.body:
### Changes:
* Added stools, which will spawn around the solar system. These stools can help the player use things like the model rocket or other areas where being shorter than normal can make something more difficult. The stool placements are not final, but they should spawn in most locations where they would be needed!
* Revamped config menu.
  * The "Height %" and "Radius %" settings now represent actual percentages, so a Height % of 100 will make the player be normal height.
* Readded native compatibility with Hiker's Mod via an API. **Delete Owen013.HikersModSHAddon, as it is now obsolete.**

releases.name: v1.3.0: preparing for Story Mode
releases.body: As I've been working on Story Mode, I realized that with all of the changes I'm making to the solar system, I'm probably introducing a lot of incompatibilities with other mods (like NH, for example). As such, I've decided that instead of building Story Mode directly into Smol Hatchling, I'll make Story Mode an addon so that the base Smol Hatchling can remain as a simple player scale manipulator. This also means that I will no longer have to update Smol Hatchling every time I release a new update for Story Mode.

releases.name: v2.0.0 Prerelease 2
releases.body:
**This is a prerelease**

This prerelease adds the different character attributes for story mode! In this, your speed and jump height are reduced slightly, which is one of the gameplay changes in story mode. You will occasionally have to use stools to get to places where a normal-sized Hearthian could simply jump! This is **enabled** by default but can be turned off in the config menu.

This is compatible with Hiker's Mod via the addon, but you will have to opt into the v1.1.0-pr1 prerelease for the addon in order for it to work properly.

releases.name: v1.2.4: Refactored for Hiker's Mod's Smol Hatchling Compatibility Addon
releases.body: Instead of building the compatibility for Smol Hatchling and Hiker's mod directly into the code, I've changed it so that this compatibility is now achieved through an addon called "Hiker's Mod Compatibility with Smol Hatchling"

releases.name: v2.0.0 Prerelease 1
releases.body:
The first of many prereleases for v2.0.0.
### Changes:
- Added stools, which are enabled by default. They appear in every location (that I know of) where being Smol™ may be detrimental to gameplay.
- Updated config menu a bit, adding separators.

### Known Issues:
- Stools can be used to travel through walls.
- If the player's size is changed in the config with Hiker's Mod installed, the walking animation speed won't update unless the Hiker's Mod config is also updated.
- If the player stands too close to a wall while Smol™, they may become ungrounded and start sliding on the ground.
- (Minor) Stools can be placed inside walls.

releases.name: v1.6.8
releases.body:
### Changes
- There is now a half-second cooldown after Wall Jumping in which you cannot Emergency Boost, which fixes an issue where you could Emergency Boost while trying to Wall Jump.
- You can no longer Wall-Jump while thrusting upwards, which fixes an issue where you would wall jump while trying to boost.
- Removed the ability to disable Wall Jumping while suited because of the above bugfix.
- The player's jump height will now scale properly with Smol Hatchling v2.0.0.

releases.body: Quick patch for compatibility with Smol Hatchling v1.5.1.

releases.name: v1.6.6: Sprinting Tweaks
releases.body:
- Reverted some very strange features that snuck into the last release.
- Sprinting is now enabled by default *everywhere.*
  - Pursuers will now pursue faster when you're sprinting.
- Made sprinting slightly slower to prevent stinky cheese.
- Emergency Boost and Floaty Physics are now experimental features that are disabled by default.
- Emergency Boosting now costs 30% of your fuel by default.
- Added an option to change the jetpack's maximum fuel capacity.

releases.name: v1.6.4: Bugfixes
releases.body:
- MonoBehaviors now properly unsubscribe from events, preventing config errors after the first loop.
- Fixed a bug that made the climbing animation not play.

releases.name: v1.6.3: Bugfixing and Tweaks
releases.body:
- Jetpack thruster flame no longer appears while sprinting if the jetpack is off or invisible.
- You can now configure how quickly you have to double-tap the jump button to do an emergency boost.
- Fixed a bug where setting the Jump Power in config wouldn't do anything
- Added an option to set your minimum jump power (how high you will jump if you don't charge your jump)
- Removed API (temporarily? lemme know if anyone actually needs it)
- You can now set the minimum acceleration you will move when using Floaty Physics and the gravity at which you will reach this acceleration.

releases.name: v1.6.2: Camera Shake Compatibility, Config Updates, and Bugfixes
releases.body:
# Hiker's Mod v1.6.2
**Changes:**
- Added compatibility with the Camera Shake mod by Streetlights Behind the Trees! Performing an Emergency Boost with the Camera Shake mod enabled will now cause the screen to shake.
  - The intensity of the camera shake can be adjusted in the config menu.
- The volume of the sound that plays when you do an Emergency Boost is now slightly quieter by default and can be changed in the config menu.
- The jetpack flame that appears when you do an Emergency Boost is just a teensy bit smaller.

**Bugfixes:**
- The ship's left thruster will no longer create a huge downward flame when you do an Emergency Boost. Thank you to Hotklou for reporting this bug!

**Behind the Scenes:**
- Added a very basic API that can be used by other mods to know when the player is sprinting or Emergency Boosting. This API is a work in progress, so if you want anything to be added to it you can let me know by opening an issue to request a feature.
- Code cleaned up for efficiency and readability.

releases.name: Input Demo Recorder v.1.0
releases.body:
* Adds the capability to record inputs, save them in a file and play them:

* Press the button `Record` to record your inputs
    * A timer will appear showing how long have you been recording
    * The button `Stop Recording` will appear, and pressing it stops the recording to it to be saved or replayed

* Press the button `Play Recorded Demo` to play the demo that you recorded when you hit the `Record` button
    * A timer will appear showing the time of the recording that is being played
    * The button `Stop Playingback` will appear, and pressing it stops the playback

* Press the button `Save Demo` to save the recorded demo from when you hit the  `Record` button, use the text box that defaults to *OuterWilds_Demo* to choose the name of the file, it will be saved in the same folder as the mod's folder

* Press the button `Play Saved Demo` to play a demo saved into a file, use the text box that defaults to *OuterWilds_Demo* to choose the name of the file, it needs to be in the same folder as the mod's folder

* When loading or saving demos you don't need to specify the file extension as they will always use the extension `.owdemo`

* This is a BepInEx plugin which works with the 1.0.10 version of Outer Wilds

releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.body:
- Added Chinese translation (thanks SheepCreater2)
- Fixed it being impossible to 100% achievements on a profile (Beginner's Luck was always reset)
- Adds semi-hidden achievements. These are achievements that devs can set up a "before earned" description to give a hint to players explicitly stating what needs to be done. (I've updated the tutorial in readme and example project if you want an easier explanation)
- Makes it so that the "X hidden achievement" box for fully secret achievements is translatable, rather than always English
- Fixes the queue on the in-game achievement popup

Thank you Stache for creating most of this update!
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了中文翻译（感谢 SheepCreater2）
- 修复了无法在个人资料中100%完成成就的问题（总是重置“新手运气”）
- 添加了半隐藏成就。这些是开发者可以设置“获得前”描述的成就，以明确提示玩家需要做什么。（我已在readme和示例项目中更新了教程，如果你需要更简单的解释）
- 使完全隐藏成就的“X个隐藏成就”框可翻译，而不是始终为英文
- 修复了游戏内成就弹窗的队列问题

感谢 Stache 创建了大部分更新！

releases.body:
- Fix custom modes's `Initialize`  being called twice or not at all instead of just once.
- Fix item lists's description field not being properly starting cleared

**Custom Suit Log Modes**

This update adds an API that allows other mods to add their custom Suit Log modes that the user can switch between (including a mode selector like in [Custom Ship Log Modes](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/customshiplogmodes/)).

The API also includes many methods to create and use item lists on the suit's helmet UI that are very similar to the ones from Custom Ship Log Modes with easy portability between the two. See the [README's guide](https://github.com/dgarroDC/SuitLog#suit-log-modes-developer-guide) for more info.

- An orange question mark is displayed when selecting a rumored entry or a planet with no revealed entries, similar to vanilla's Ship Log Map Mode.
- More internal changes were made to progress the future custom modes feature, particularly for item lists. In fact, the question mark was added for a better compatibility between Ship Log and Suit Log item lists.

- Planets (and other locations) with no entries revealed but that are visible in the vanilla Ship Log's Map Mode are now also visible in the Suit Log (also with the message "No discoveries yet."). This also includes New Horizon's planets (the ones without `invisibleWhenHidden` set in `true`).
- With this update a large internal refactor to the codebase was done, moving most of the logic to a `SuitLogMode`  and a `SuitLogItemList`. This doesn't change anything to the mod functionality yet, but it's a first step to a future update that will include the possibility to others mods to add Custom Suit Log Modes, allowing them to use the Suit Log UI with a similar API to the Custom Ship Log Modes "Item List" API methods (this should help porting existing Ship Log Modes that use those methods to the Suit Log, although there will be some different that will be clarified when the update is complete).

Fix NRE errors when starting the solar system after Outer Wilds Patch 14 (#1). The errors were harmless, only causing unnecessary noise in the logs, so this fix avoids it.

Thanks @xen-42 and @Ixrec for reporting this issue!

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body:
*Carson* has received its `1.0` update!

# What's new?
### Ah jeez, what *hasn't* changed since release 0.4?

- The *Carson* star itself has been given tweaks and a fresh coat of paint.
- Added new nebular skybox.
- All planets have been completely rebuilt and revamped with new terrain as well as given proper generated heightmaps. No more taking the standard terrain texture and grayscaling it, save a few tweaks here and there.
-  Increased heightmap resolution to 1024 at the equator thanks to the introduction of LODs allowing for higher resolution while keeping frames stable. It allows for mountains, cracks, craters, and shorelines to be much more defined, and helps to keep things detailed when on the surface.
- Added another new planet named *Dester*.
- Added props such as trees and cacti to some planets, further helping to keep things detailed when on the surface.
- Added rain to Pyer.
- Tweaked gas giants.
- **New original flight music composed by yours truly (will likely post it on my YouTube music channel soon)!**

# What now?
### Well, a couple things...
The original idea behind *Carson* was that I wanted to create a star system that felt immersive.  The celestial bodies showcased in *Outer Wilds* as well as the beautiful star systems made by other talented people are rather tiny; you can walk across the circumference of a planet in about a minute give or take, which isn't big at all.

I figured the best thing to do was make a much bigger star system, but also without being *too* big. It's a very sensitive scale to balance, mind you, because if you make it too big then it'll just become boring and likely frustrating. But too small and it breaks immersion.

*Carson* was inspired by the *Kerbol* system (as well as modded solar systems via *Kopernicus*) as shown in the famous spacecraft simulator *Kerbal Space Program*, as seen by *Carson*'s overall planetary designs.

What I wanted to figure out was just *how big* to make my objects. I settled around the size they are now. I estimated it to be the sweet spot for size. Again, I wanted my system to be big enough to be immersive, but not too big to be frustrating for people or boring. I had to take into consideration that the ship, vanilla-wise anyways, is pretty slow too.

Obviously, this mod has its flaws; a lot of them, mind you. But I've had fun developing this mod and some of the wonderful people like Trifid on the [*Outer Wilds Modding* Discord server](https://discord.gg/RUD

releases.name: Potential fix for non-per-key keyboards
releases.body:
Added some default event bindings for zoned devices to hopefully display the ambient effects for certain keyboards (e.g. Apex 3).

Fun fact: Steelseries has an rgb zone called "all" that apparently means "all, but only if your keyboard can illuminate each key individually, otherwise none"
releases.bodyZh:
添加了一些默认的事件绑定，用于区域设备，希望能显示某些键盘（例如 Apex 3）的环境效果。

有趣的事实：Steelseries 有一个名为 "all" 的 RGB 区域，其含义似乎是 "全部，但只有当你的键盘能够单独点亮每个按键时才有效，否则无效"。

releases.body:
v1.0.0

2nd Anniversary Edition!

New Features
- A new short mystery with new dialogue, ship logs, and more!
- The mod finally has a proper ending!
- Integration with the Achievements+ mod!
- Lots of improvements to the Ship Log!
- Kept the vibe low-budget for that “baby’s first mod” feel.

General Polishing
- Bumped mod’s OWML version (2.11.1 -> 2.13.0).
- Updated json files for newer schemas.
- Updated the README and credits.
- Added ‘known-issues’ document to ‘developer’ folder to track known errors and bugs.
- Rewrote code in a lot of documents solely to confuse people.

Custom System Changes
- Lost Strings: Rearranged some props and adjusted spawning.
- Green Base: New texture, props, logs, and more.
- Bracket’s Rest: New texture, new props, and is now the moon of Green Base.
- Dried Tears: Now has an asteroid belt and an inclined orbit.

Other Tweaks
- New popup when launching the game.
- Added planets to the title screen.
- Adjusted ship log images in stock solar system.
- Fixed some English typos and inconsistencies.

v1.0.0

第二周年纪念版！

新功能
- 新增一个短篇谜题，包含新的对话、飞船日志和更多内容！

releases.body:
- For item lists without the description field, now they start scrolling later when navigating down, the selection arrow can now go down to the displayed 12th UI item instead of the 5th, which was wasting a lot of free vertical space. It is still consistent with vanilla, but counting from the bottom of the list instead of the top.
- Vanilla modes now are displayed at the top of the mode selection list instead of at the bottom.
- Item lists are no longer displayed over the Ship Log's exterior border (the item lists's root object is now the sibling following the description field in the objects hierarchy). Because of this, The Hatchling's Journal cursor no longer renders over that border anymore, making it more look consistent with the vanilla modes.
releases.bodyZh:
- 对于没有描述字段的项目列表，在向下导航时现在开始滚动得更晚，选择箭头现在可以向下滚动到显示的第12个UI项目，而不是第5个，这样就浪费了很多免费的垂直空间。它仍然与原版保持一致，但计数是从列表的底部而不是顶部开始的。
- 原版模式现在显示在模式选择列表的顶部，而不是底部。
- 项目列表不再显示在船志的外部边界之上（项目列表的根对象现在是对象层次结构中描述字段后面的同级对象）。由于这个原因，雏鸟的日记光标不再渲染在那条边界上，使其看起来更与原版模式一致。

releases.body: Fix more issues from Outer Wilds Patch 14 (I'm done waiting for the hotfix!) related to the photo in item lists: the rectangle is a square again (if the description field is enabled), the image now properly fits inside it, and fixed a NRE error that was logged every loop related to the photo mask.

Fix most remaining identified issues of Outer Wilds Patch 14:
- There is now a new upper right prompt list used for custom modes instead of the Map Mode one, so now they are visible again!
- The selection arrow is now properly horizontally placed on item lists without the photo area (including mode selector)
- Item lists without the description field (including mode selector) are expanded vertically again
- For now, item lists will be forcibly set their UI sizes to regular (so they would look like the Map Mode item list with regular size), and this includes the description field (since this is shared with vanilla modes, this size is restored when closing the item list), but this could be made configurable in the future
- The new mask for the photo now has graphics disabled for item lists, avoiding undesirable effects like a white image covering the question mark. Mobius might disable this graphic in the Map Mode on the next hotfix, making this change unnecessary (but shouldn't cause any issues)

There are still minor issues. For example, some item lists (for example, in Journal) don't have the photo properly placed (related to mask?), the upper right prompts in Map Mode look bad when using large UI (because of the extra prompt and the fact that in large UI these are placed vertically), and also some error logs related to the mask. However, I want to wait for the Outer Wilds hotfix before tackling these issues (unless the hotfix takes a lot of time to be released or isn't released at all).

This is a dirty hotfix after Outer Wilds Patch 14 issues to prevent other mods from exploding. There are still issues to be fixed: the selection arrow in the mode selector mode is wrongly placed, item lists without a description field aren't expanded vertically (including the mode selector mode) and upper right prompts aren't visible for custom modes (now map mode and rumor mode have their own list that is visible only when the corresponding mode is active, instead of a global one like before, and with this hotfix custom modes are using the map mode one). Probably a lot more issues!

New Horizons should work now, but the upper right prompts in Interstellar Mode (change mode, exit ship log...) are currently invisible.

Adds 3 more "Item List" API methods: `ItemListUpdateListUI`, `ItemListGetItemsUI` and `ItemListGetIndexUI`, more info about them in the [README](https://github.com/dgarroDC/CustomShipLogModes#creating-ui-item-lists).

**Important notice:** This update is actually required for [The Hatchling's Journal](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/thehatchlingsjournal/) (the mod doesn't work without it), but I forgot to release this patch before releasing the mod, sorry for the inconvenience!
Now when the "Select Mode" menu is opened, the selected item in the list will be the last active mode (the active mode when the menu was opened).
Fixed to work with Outer Wilds Patch 15 (updated game libs).

Note that this a non-diegetic feature: it isn't fullscreen on the in-game computer, it's fullscreen on your monitor (or game window), allowing you to appreciate the reels in all their glory and without being affected by lights from the game world, offering a more CINEMATIC experience.

releases.body:
**"Slide Reel Player" Custom Mode**
Moves reel entries out of Map Mode to new custom ship log mode. Map Mode still has the vanilla reel player.
Fix increased loading times (#6) by removing a lot of expensive operations (many of them since release 1.2.0) during mod setup

Relaunch of the mod, rebranded as **Ship Log Slide Reel Player Plus** because [Outer Wilds Patch 13](https://www.mobiusdigitalgames.com/news/patch-13-is-now-available) officially implemented watching slide reels and visions in the Ship Log, so the purpose of the mod is now adding the previous  **Ship Log Slide Reel Player** as an enhanced alternative to the vanilla one (and more features will be implemented in the future).

Main changes since the last release:
- The mod now works with Outer Wilds 1.1.13!
- Most of the reels and visions aren't required to watch them again to make the mod know that you already watched them, using the new functionality of the official implementation that links reels/vision with known Ship Log facts (although this was previously possible by me in the past by manually specifying the facts, the new feature makes it easier for me).
- Removed the API used by [Suit Log](https://github.com/dgarroDC/SuitLog) to show the reels/visions in it. I could have kept it and the Suit Log would have the Reel Player again, but I have a plan for a major redesign of Ship Log Slide Reel Player Plus that would need to completely change the way these mods communicate.

Added the feature to play reels/visions automatically as an alternative to manually changing the slide.
_Note:_ This feature is also added to the [Suit Log](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/suitlog/) mod if you already have the ["Suit Log Slide Reel Player" Update (1.2.0)](https://github.com/dgarroDC/SuitLog/releases/tag/1.2.0).
Fix some bugs when watching real reels/visions: music not playing, visions going fast and locking, not being marked as read in ship log, probably more... Thanks @likemauro for the report!

### Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed a regression in the previous version where multiple folders were missing from the release.

Integrated the additions from @TRSasasusu's [Enhance Divergence Mod](https://github.com/TRSasasusu/TinyPatchForDivergence) into the main mod, which include:

- Major visual adjustments to a certain location.
- Dynamically updating text elements that correspond to changes in the environment.  

This is the largest change introduced in the update, as it adds code to what was previously a New Horizon's add-on. In the spirit of the January 2023 New Horizon's Mod Jam, the vast majority of Divergence continues to only use features provided by New Horizons, as the additions from Enhance Divergence Mod only concern visuals and small, immersive details. Once again, a huge thank you to @TRSasasusu for creating the Enhance Divergence Mod, and for general assistance with the project itself since its release!

Along with the integration of Enhance Divergence Mod, there have been several other improvements and bug fixes in order to make the mod more enjoyable:

### Fixes and Improvements

- Made a certain set of symbols visible in a specific view.
- Fixed a hole in the geometry that was visible in a specific view. 
- Fixed a certain fire extinguishing itself near the end of the loop.
- Made the intended starting point of the mod a little more clear.
- Tweaked some strings and fixed some typos, and adjusted a few conversations. 
- Removed a text log that wasn't very useful in telling you where you need to go.
- Updated Japanese translation (thanks @TRSasasusu!)

### Additions
- Added a much faster way to return to a particular location.
- Added a way to reset progress for a specific puzzle without restarting the loop.

- Moved a certain arrival point to its original intended spot, so that performing a certain feat is much less tedious
- Text corrections and improvements
- Fixed an issue with the Japanese translation (thanks @TRSasasusu!)

### Additions
- Added another way to leave a particular location.

releases.body:
* Added a new ship log to make it more obvious where the ending is
* Added a new sequence to the ending to tie this mod to Magistarium
* Added (jank) QSB support. Only some things are synced (spoilers below)

Synced:
* Lake Core lever
* All Lava Core Shrine buttons
* Derelict Ship keypad
* The Final Button

Not Synced:
* Lava Core pressure plates (a pain to rewrite and would completely nullify the puzzles)
* Elevators (could require new animations and potentially tedious for play)
* Final music
Certain elements that you are intended to activate from a distance will look weird for another player that is close to and looking at the element, but it will not have any negative affect on gameplay.

* 所有熔岩核祭坛按钮
* 废弃飞船键盘

不同步的：
* 熔岩核压力板（重写会很麻烦，并且会完全使谜题失效）
* 电梯（可能需要新的动画，并且可能对游戏体验很繁琐）

The Lava Core will get a much larger overhaul eventually, but now you should hopefully not pull out your hair or feel you need cheats to beat it.

releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- NomaiVR compatibility work from @theCapypara :
	- A "Show Unlock Notification" setting that shows a text notification at the center of the screen whenever an item is unlocked. This is primarily intended for NomaiVR players, since the normal in-game console is difficult to read in VR.
	- Normally NomaiVR forces you to wake up facing GD, just like when you wake up in the vanilla game. The randomizer will now actively disable this "feature", since it becomes a bug when the randomizer puts you on another planet or randomizes orbits.
	- Reimplements the in-game console to follow the player's view while fixing several cases where it would fail to appear.
	- Extend NomaiVR's solution for text input fields in the main menu to also work for the in-game console.
	- Fixes NomaiVR's handling of the Translator and Signalscope, especially when ArchipelagoRandomizer prevents you from equipping them.
	- Fixes NomaiVR re-enabling the Landing Camera after ArchipelagoRandomizer disables it.
	- Edits NomaiVR's ship UI to say when the Signalscope, Scout, and Landing Camera are "not available".
- Song of the Universe tracking fixes:
	- Fixed Universal Tracker "Go Mode" for Song of the Universe goals
	- Fixed an in-game tracker bug that would cause inconsistently crashes on Song of the Universe slots

安装说明 [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation)。

releases.name: v1.2.2
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- @RS_Mind attempted to work around a Forgotten Castaways bug where the "Recursive Node" sometimes doesn't spawn. It's too inconsistent for anyone to pin down exact causes, but we suspect having many other mods loaded makes it more likely, which would explain why only randomizer players seem to be reporting it.
- Logic fixes:
	- Since you can't carry both a DLC Artifact and the Echo Hike Threader at the same time, Starlit Cove is no longer in logic if the Threader is your only logical way of reaching Cinder Isles (fixes #98 ).
	- Added an explicit "Hearth's Neighbor Museum Plate" region to the HN1 logic to help remind players how to unlock the warp to the HN1 system
	- Suitless logic for the text wheel inside the Frozen Shuttle now requires Spacesuit
	- "DW: Starlit Cove Upper Tower Floors" logic is now aware that Raft Docks Patch is an alternative to Dream Totem Patch
- "Find Gabbro's Ship" location is no longer incorrectly triggered by the ship on Bracket's Rest in FQ.
- Fix Nomai text coloring exception spam on unscouted locations (the feature is still unsupported/broken, but this quick fix reduces the odds of it breaking unrelated stuff)
releases.bodyZh:
安装说明 [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation)。

- @RS_Mind 尝试解决一个《被遗忘的拓荒者》的bug，即“递归节点”有时不会生成。这太不稳定了，任何人都不可能确定具体原因，但我们怀疑加载了许多其他模组会使其更容易发生，这也解释了为什么只有随机化玩家似乎在报告它。
- 逻辑修复：
	- 由于你无法同时携带一个DLC遗物和回响徒步线程器，如果线程器是你到达灰烬群岛的唯一逻辑方式，那么星光湾在逻辑上不再存在（修复 #98 ）。
	- 在HN1逻辑中添加了一个明确的“哈斯邻居博物馆板”区域，以帮助提醒玩家如何解锁通往HN1系统的跃迁。

releases.name: v1.2.1
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- [Updated the Archipelago.MultiClient.Net library to v6.7.1](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1043855558303821844/1484975530968354966). The change most likely to affect players is Berserker's "[Request Datapackage as individual responses](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago.MultiClient.Net/pull/135)", which should help prevent timeout errors when connecting to large multiworlds.
- Forgotten Castaways logic fixes from @msyverw:
	- The "Deep Bramble via Warp Drive" region now logically connects to the (shipless) "Deep Bramble" region, which fixes some cases where the early parts of FC were incorrectly out of logic
	- Tweaked the regions of "DB Ship Log: Stranded Nomai 5 - Warp" and "FC Ship Log: Bramble's Doorstep 2 - Nomai" so that they won't be in logic until you have logical access to *both* systems, since you can't get a ship log fact for the system you aren't in
	- In-game tracker now uses the correct logic region for Deep Bramble spawns
	- The connection from a Deep Bramble spawn to the "Deep Bramble via Warp Drive" region now logically requires only Launch Codes, not Deep Bramble Coordinates as it accidentally used to
	- "FC Ship Log: Pillar Town 2 - Gift" now logically requires the Expanded Dictionary
- Fixed suitless logic by making Nomai shuttle locations require Spacesuit to reach via gravity cannon recalls. Some time ago a base game patch made it no longer possible to move Nomai orbs from inside the ship, which is a problem for suitless players. The only logic this actually broke was entering a Nomai shuttle by recalling it to the corresponding gravity cannon, since you would suffocate while moving the orb to recall it.

	- Some dead code required by older Universal Tracker versions has been cleaned up (specifically the `interpret_slot_data` stub)

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Echo Hike story mod integration (thanks @aXu-AP ). The main appeal of this mod is the unique "Threader" item, which is a grapple beam/hook that works on any surface in the game.
	- `enable_eh_mod` option. When this is `true`, Threader use will be in-logic for:
		- Entering the BH Forge without a "warp path" to the Hanging City Ceiling
		- Climbing up into the bottom floor of GD tower rather than solving the Imaging Rule puzzles above
		- (if `enable_eote_dlc` is also `true`) Navigating The Stranger without rafts / Stranger Light Modulator
		- (if `enable_fc_mod` is also `true`) Reaching the Eye Signal Lab without the crystal puzzle
	- After receiving the "Threader" AP item, actual Threaders will be placed near all of your possible spawn points, including DLC and story mod systems.
	- 11 new AP locations (3 default, 8 logsanity) on the Echo Hike planet itself
- The "[Archipelago Hints]" option in NPC dialogue trees has been moved near the bottom, to reduce the risk of accidentally spending your hint by mashing through the dialogue (thanks aXu-AP)
- The custom loading spinner (with the 6 colored moons instead of 1 orange moon) has been fixed
- Previously, the "AP Console: Drop All AP Server Messages" setting would write AP server messages to the mod logs instead of the in-game console. Now, it won't write the messages anywhere at all. Hopefully this improves attempts to use this setting to mitigate instability in large multiworlds.

- 回声徒步故事模组集成（感谢 @aXu-AP）。此模组的主要吸引力是独特的“Threader”物品，它是一种 grappling beam/hook，可在游戏的任何表面上使用。

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Fixed slots with Deep Bramble spawns spawning back on Timber Hearth after scanning certain FC signals or finishing the story of FC (thanks RS_Mind)
- Fixed `goal: echoes_of_the_eye` slots completing their goal by finishing the story of FC instead of EotE (thanks RS_Mind)
- In the in-game tracker, opening one of the checklist categories can now be done with the "interact" button as well as the "confirm" button (thanks aXu-AP)
- Hide the in-game AP console when accessing the ship log (thanks aXu-AP)
- Fixed the in-game tracker sometimes failing to update logic when AP server "cheats" in an item (thanks aXu-AP)
- dlc_only is meant to disable all story mods, but we forgot to make it disable FC as well. Now it does, which prevents fuzzer failures (thanks gerbiljames)

releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Forgotten Castaways story mod integration (thanks @msyverw and @rs_mind ) 
	- Adds an `enable_fc_mod` option, of course.
	- 13 new items. That includes 6 frequencies/signals, a "Translator (Deep Bramble)" if `split_translator: true`, and 6 custom items specific to Forgotten Castaways' progression.
	- 54 new default locations, and 118 new logsanity locations, for a total of 172 new locations. This raises the maximum possible location count for an Outer Wilds slot from 659 to 831.
	- And finally, a new spawn option: `deep_bramble`
- Fixed UT "go mode" so it actually checks your `goal` option, instead of incorrectly defaulting to `song_of_five` logic.
- Corrected item flag handling. I believe the only player-facing consequence is that now in-game hint text will correctly use the progression color for items which are both progression and useful.

releases.name: v0.3.20
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- From @t-rbernard: "Death Link Roulette" mod/client options, which can be used to randomly convert incoming death links into various trap item effects
- shuffle_spacesuit issues:
	- Fixed the ship's "Return Suit" prompt appearing and *working* even when you aren't wearing the suit. This bug allowed you to "take off" and then put on the suit without receiving the "Spacesuit" AP item.
	- Fixed the Spacesuit appearing in your ship (before receiving the "Spacesuit" AP item) when you warp into a New Horizons custom system
	- The warp to Sun Station is supposed to logically require Spacesuit, but due to a lambda capture bug (found by mysteryem's new fuzzer hook) it didn't in practice. This has now been fixed, so it's no longer theoretically possible for Spacesuit to get placed inside the Sun Station.
	- Somehow, the in-game tracker had an equivalent bug despite being completely different code, so it was not showing the "(Item: Spacesuit)" requirement on this connection. That's also fixed now.
- Fixed warping from a NewHorizons system back to the vanilla Outer Wilds system. Previously, this would often hang forever on the loading screen. (thanks msyverw / RS_Mind for pinning this down and prototyping a fix)
- Changed the implementation details of trap_type_weights and upgrade_counts so that:
	- The keys can now be omitted, with the same meaning as an explicit 0. For example, `trap_type_weights: { "Supernova Trap": 1 }` is valid now; no more listing 0s for all the other traps.
	- These options can now also be edited by AP's built-in "Options Creator" (and probably unofficial webhosts).
- Tweaked the tracker descriptions for Gabbro's Island 3 and 4 so they now explicitly say exactly how many loops are required to unlock these log facts
- Finally removed all of the [DEBUG] mod settings
- Fixed the `Location SLF__TH_VILLAGE_X3 is missing an AP id, so not sending anything to the AP server` warning

releases.name: v0.3.19
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Fixed taking off the spacesuit in seeds where you wake up wearing it. This unbreaks a critical puzzle in one of the story mods, which we suspect was somehow broken by base game patch 16.
- Add a "AP Console: Drop All AP Server Messages" mod setting, partly because larger asyncs can be too spammy even with the existing filter setting, but also because we suspect excessive console messages are destabilizing Outer Wilds in general for some randomizer players.
- Worked around a bug that would break resuming a randomized expedition if an AP item with quotes in its name landed in that OW slot. Thanks Xayah for reporting this.
	- For what it's worth, the other AP game which exposed this bug was Paper Mario: TTYD. We don't know how many other games might be affected.
- Corrected tracker description for "HN2: Reading Room (Memory Cube)"; somehow it was a copy-paste of an unrelated HN1 location
- Corrected logic for "FQ Ship Log: Fret's Quest 4 - Reported" to be about translating the ritual recorder, not completing the entire song for Tuner
- Prevent death links being sent to/from a slot you're no longer playing by explicitly cleaning up the old deathlink service when switching slots.
- Tweak in-game hint text from "everywhere you've already been" to "everywhere you went before asking me for hints" to avoid implying that we're regenerating the hints every time you talk to the same traveler.
- Moved early_key_item implementation earlier to comply with Core AP PR #4481, hopefully fixing some subtle conflicts with start_inventory_from_pool and (non_)local_items.
- This won't affect players soon or directly, but I've added [the proposed apworld manifest](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/4516) to outer_wilds.apworld and used [the proposed apworld build tool](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/5340) to create it. This won't benefit players anytime soon, but hopefully it's a step towards a proper core AP toolchain for managing custom apworlds.

releases.name: v0.3.18

releases.name: v1.5.0: New Viewmodel Arms, Landing Animation, and More

- All tools/items have a new viewmodel arm that utilizes these posable joints.

### New Landing Animation

### Sprinting Animation

- View Bobbing, Hand Height Offset (Dynamic Tool Position), and Hand Sway (Tool Sway) look slightly different (less nauseating).

releases.name: v1.4.4: Bugfixing
releases.body:
**This version has been tested with and works on Astral Codec and the Outsider. It should also work with any other story mods. Please submit an issue if you encounter bugs.**

### Fixes
- Viewmodel Arms no longer break the game when picking up certain items placed by other mods.
- Fixed the Viewmodel Arm position for the Jeff Scroll.
- Fixed an issue where the Spacesuit Viewmodel Arm would have weird shading or appear fully dark in certain areas.

releases.name: v1.4.3: Bugfixing and Performance
releases.body:
### Bugfixes
- Viewmodel Arms will no longer appear on dropped items placed by other mods such as Astral Codec.
- Viewmodel Arms will no longer throw NullReferenceExceptions every frame when The Outsider is installed.
- View Bobbing will now scale properly when resizing the Player with Smol Hatchling.

### Changes
- Performance improvements
  - Viewmodel Arms are now only created when an item/tool is equipped for the first time, and are deactivated when the item is dropped. This means there are no longer 100+ Viewmodel Arms all calling LateUpdate() (or, worse, throwing NREs) every frame.
- Tweaked default settings to be less vomit-inducing.

- A certain ending instrument is now in sync

releases.name: Release v2.3.0
releases.body:
I've decided to switch to a new style of updates, which will usually be smaller and will focus on a specific theme. This update is the first of that new style, and the main focus is the ship's signalscope!


# New Settings

- **Enable Ship Signalscope Zoom** - Lets you zoom in while using the ship's signalscope
- **Disable Signalscope Brackets** - Makes finding signals more difficult by turning off the guiding brackets
- **Mod Changelog** - Brings up a list of all the release notes for previous updates so you can see what changed (copied over from GitHub)


# Signalscope Commands

In previous updates, enabling the **Ship Signal** would allow you to cycle through a list of commands while the signal was in focus on your signalscope. That feature received a big upgrade in this update, including a new UI and many more commands to mess around with!

To make finding them easier, the commands are also separated into different groups now, which are listed below. (head to the modding website page for a full list of commands)

- **Component Commands** - Controls specific parts of the ship, like the reactor and cockpit buttons
- **Module Commands** - Ejects different parts of the ship
- **Autopilot Commands** - Lets you toggle any of the autopilot functions (except **Input Hold**)
- **Targeting Commands** - Sets the ship's lock-on target without needing to be in the ship
- **Other Commands** - Miscellaneous commands that didn't fit in any of the other groups


# Feature Changes

- Renamed the **Add Ship Signal** setting to **Ship Signal Type** to allow for using a regular signal
- Signals will now be visible on the ship's signalscope when it is damaged, but will be much more difficult to track
- The **Portable Fuel Tank** will now react to collisions when placed on moving objects (shuttles, rafts, etc)
- The scout can now blow up the **Portable Fuel Tank**


# Bug Fixes

- Going offline no longer breaks the mod
- The signal dish on the outside of the ship no longer freezes in place after being repaired
- Enabling **Auto Align** and blowing up the ship no longer causes the ship's carcass to spiral away into deep space
- Reeling the **Tether** in/out is now disabled when player movement is disabled
- The sound of the cockpit being ejected can't be heard across the universe anymore
- Fixed a bug where the ship explosion would only appear for one person in multiplayer
- Fixed a bug where **Position Hold** would turn itself off in mu
releases.bodyZh:
我决定切换到一种新的更新风格，通常会更小，并专注于一个特定主题。这次更新是那种新风格的第一次，主要重点是飞船的信号扫描仪！


# 新设置

- **启用飞船信号扫描仪缩放** - 允许你在使用飞船信号扫描仪时进行缩放
- **禁用信号扫描仪括号** - 通过关闭引导括号，使寻找信号变得更加困难
- **模组变更日志** - 显示所有先前更新的发布说明列表，以便你可以看到发生了什么变化（从GitHub复制过来）


# 信号扫描仪命令

在之前的更新中，启用**飞船信号**将允许你在信号聚焦在信号扫描仪上时循环浏览一系列命令。该功能在这个更新中得到了重大升级，包括一个新的UI和许多更多可以用来玩的命令！

为了更容易找到它们，命令现在也被分为不同的组，如下所示。（前往模组网站页面以获取完整的命令列表）

- **组件命令** - 控制飞船的特定部分，如反应堆和驾驶舱按钮
- **模块命令** - 排出飞船的不同部分
- **自动驾驶命令** - 允许你切换任何自动驾驶功能（除了**输入保持**）
- **目标锁定命令** - 设置飞船的锁定目标，而无需进入飞船
- **其他命令** - 不属于任何其他组的杂项命令


# 功能变更

- 将**添加飞船信号**设置重命名为**飞船信号类型**，以允许使用普通信号
- 当飞船受损时，信号现在会在飞船的信号扫描仪上可见，但将很难跟踪
- **便携式燃料箱**现在在放置在移动物体上时（穿梭机、筏子等）会对碰撞做出反应
- 探测器现在可以引爆**便携式燃料箱**


# 错误修复

- 离线不再会破坏模组
- 飞船外部的信号盘在修复后不再会冻结在原地
- 启用**自动对齐**并引爆飞船不再会导致飞船的残骸螺旋飞入深空
- 当玩家移动被禁用时，收放**系绳**的功能现在已被禁用
- 驾驶舱被弹出时的声音现在无法在宇宙中听到
- 修复了一个多人游戏中飞船爆炸只对一个人可见的bug
- 修复了一个**位置保持**会自己在多人游戏中关闭的bug

- Fixed a bug where enabling water cooling and overloading the reactor would have no effect on **Passive Temperature Gain**

- Fixed a bug where disabling **Remember Ship State** and warping to a new system would still remember the settings
- Fixed a bug where **Disable Rotation Speed Limit** would also increase the ship's look sensitivity
- Fixed a bug where the reactor could be overloaded while repairing it
- Fixed a bug where holding the roll button when the ship takes stun damage would prevent roll mode from disabling
- Fixed a bug where the tether could be accidentally detached while piloting the ship and using free look
- Fixed a bug where the cockpit ice would sometimes become desynced while in multiplayer
- Fixed a bug where the ship would desync when the engine sputtered while in multiplayer
- Fixed a bug where the preset setting could not be made hidden using the API
- Fixed a bug where the **AddTemperatureZone()** function in the API was broken

releases.name: Release v2.2.0
releases.body:
Read the changelog on the GitHub releases page if the full version isn't displayed!

# New Settings
- **Enable Quantum Ship** - Makes the ship quantum while on the Quantum Moon
- **Add Resource Pump** - Adds a pump to the back of your ship that allows you to refill your ship's resources (fuel, oxygen, water) or fire them out of the pump in a very wasteful manner
- **Use Water Tank** - Makes water one of your ship's resources and adds a gauge for it in the cockpit, other features will need to consume water to function
- **Water Drain Multiplier** - Adjusts how quickly devices drain your water reserves
- **Add Water Cooling** - Adds a lever next to the ship log that turns on water cooling, which consumes water to prevent your ship from getting hot
- **Allow Reactor Overload** - Lets you interact with the reactor component to overload it, which prevents your ship from getting cold but makes the reactor explode faster
- **Temperature Difficulty** - Controls how dangerous the side effects of high/low temperature are
- **Buttons Require Flight Chair** - Prevents you from interacting with buttons in the cockpit unless you're piloting the ship
- **Remember Ship State** - Preserves the currently selected settings and the state of the ship (resource levels, damage, etc) while warping between solar systems, when you die the ship will reset and the settings will update
- **Enable Gas Leak** - Not recommended
- Added **ExperimentalSettings.json** to the mod folder

# Feature Changes
- The ship gravity crystal can now be duplicated with the **Unlimited Items** setting
- Split the **Enable Repair Wrench** setting into Disabled/Enabled/Required, where Enabled speeds up repairs while holding the wrench and Required requires you to be holding the wrench
- Replaced the **Faulty Heat Regulators** setting with **Passive Temperature Gain**, which lets you gain "passive cold-ness" as well
- Higher values of **Cyclone Chaos** will now make cyclones deal damage to the ship
- Renamed **Disable Automatic Lights** to **Keep Power On**

# Temperature Rework
- Cold areas no longer apply passive damage to the ship
- Cold areas now make the ship more vurnerable to impact damage
- The ship engine will now start like usual after stalling at the cost of damage to the ship
- The inside glass of the cockpit will now freeze over if the reactor heats up and the outside temperature is low
- Hot areas now increase the strength of the ship thrusters
- Hot areas now pass

releases.name: PodracingTracker v0.2.0
releases.body:
## 0.2.0

- Added support for LiveSplit.
- Added overlay destination selector: Main HUD, Landing monitor, Space suit HUD (WIP).
- Exposed **Content** folder next to the DLL (editable JSON/LSS data).
- Overlay corners moved to **RuleGuiCorners.json** (removed in-menu per-rule corner options).
- Refactored for maintainability.

Install: extract **TheIterator.PodracingTracker.zip** so PodracingTracker.dll, manifest.json, default-config.json, and **Content** sit in your mod folder (OWML mods directory for **TheIterator.PodracingTracker**).

See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/5PIterator/Podracing-Tracker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for LiveSplit setup steps.
releases.bodyZh:
## 0.2.0

- 添加了对LiveSplit的支持。
- 添加了覆盖层目标选择器：主HUD、着陆监视器、宇航服HUD（开发中）。
- 暴露了DLL旁边的**内容**文件夹（可编辑的JSON/LSS数据）。
- 覆盖层角落移动到**RuleGuiCorners.json**（移除了菜单中的每条规则角落选项）。
- 为可维护性进行了重构。

安装：解压**TheIterator.PodracingTracker.zip**，使PodracingTracker.dll、manifest.json、default-config.json和**内容**位于您的模组文件夹中（对于**TheIterator.PodracingTracker**的OWML模组目录）。

参见[CHANGELOG](https://github.com/5PIterator/Podracing-Tracker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)了解LiveSplit设置步骤。

releases.name: PodracingTracker v0.1.0
releases.body: Podracing is a challenge in Outer Wilds revolving around flying around the Solar System and landing on specific locations. The more locations you land on, the higher your score. The Podracing Tracker modification is then a mod specifically designed to track the score and rules of Podracing.
releases.bodyZh: 星际拓荒中的飞行竞速是一项挑战，围绕在飞行穿越太阳系并在特定位置着陆。你着陆的位置越多，你的得分就越高。因此，飞行竞速追踪器模组是一个专门设计用来追踪飞行竞速得分和规则的模组。

**Jam提交版本是Diorama v0.4.1和Mod Jam 5 v1.0.3。**

releases.name: On A Rail v1.1.1
releases.body:
A QoL update based on feedback.
- All text has been moved to translation .json files
- Added Simplified Chinese translation by @NanFyn
- Additional ship logs & adjustments to ship log layout
- The geometry of Hollow Pillar on Spruce Caboose has been adjusted for ease of access
- The water on Spruce Caboose is now less murky
- It's now possible to escape the water on Spruce Caboose if the player runs out of jetpack fuel
- Hearthian fuel canisters have been replaced by Nomaian fuel canisters
- A fact that previously required identifying a signal to display alternative text now only requires entering a specific location
- Ghost Matter volumes have been tweaked
- Certain SectorCullGroups will no longer cause geometry to fade into existence when interacted with
- Time Slicing no longer applies to certain gravity volumes connected by warp pads
- The radius of sectors have been adjusted per planet
- Notification volumes created with New Horizons have been replaced with ones from the base game
- An item that was hard to find is now slightly easier to find (and has an entry location once it has been found)
- If the player reaches an end game location without a certain ship log, a rumor will be learned instead of a fact
- The whistle has its volume boosted during the ending
- If the player has a certain ship log, a screen prompt will be shown on screen during the ending
- Controllers with rumble support will no longer continuously vibrate during the ending after fading to black
- Geswaldo has been added (You will _never_ find him)
releases.bodyZh:
基于反馈的质量更新。
- 所有文本已移至翻译 .json 文件
- 添加了简体中文翻译 by @NanFyn
- 增加了飞船日志 & 调整了飞船日志布局
- 云杉车队的空心柱几何结构已调整，以便更容易进入
- 云杉车队的海水现在变得不那么浑浊
- 如果玩家在云杉车队耗尽喷气背包燃料，现在可以逃离海水
- 哈斯人燃料罐已被诺麦人燃料罐取代
- 以前需要识别信号来显示替代文本的一个事实，现在只需要进入特定位置
- 幽灵物质体积已被调整
- 某些 SectorCullGroups 在交互时将不再导致几何体淡入存在
- 时间切片不再适用于通过跃迁板连接的某些重力体积
- 行星的扇区半径已根据每个行星进行调整
- 使用新地平线创建的通知体积已被基础游戏中的通知体积取代
- 一个原本难以找到的物品现在稍微容易找到（找到后会有一个入口位置）
- 如果玩家在没有特定飞船日志的情况下到达游戏结束地点，将学习到一个传闻而不是一个事实
- 结尾期间哨声音量已提升
- 如果玩家有特定飞船日志，结尾期间屏幕上会显示屏幕提示
- 支持震动功能的控制器在黑屏后不再在结尾期间持续震动
- Geswaldo 已添加（你将永远不会找到他）

releases.name: On A Rail v1.1.0
releases.body:
A major patch that completely revamps almost everything!

-A certain planet has been made spookier to deal with there being multiple suns in the system
-The Ernesto family tree has been trimmed significantly to make navigation easier
-Fish will do a better job at trying to avoid the ship (Give them a break, they didn't go to college)
-Fish will no longer destroy the ship
-Ship logs are fully implemented! Entry Locations, Rumors, Alt Text, etc.
-Hints are now more descriptive about how to proceed and more clearly state what they intend to teach.
-The ending is now less vague.
-Fixes for various stretched or misaligned textures
-The local sun will forcibly have its light radius set to 2500m (Someone else fixed it because it wasn't my fault? Too bad! Band-aid solution stays!)
releases.bodyZh:
一个重大更新，几乎完全改动了所有内容！

- 某个星球被做得更加阴森，以应对系统中有多颗太阳的情况
- 埃尔内斯托家族树被大幅简化，以方便导航
- 鱼会更好地尝试避开飞船（给它们一点休息时间，它们没有上大学）
- 鱼不再会摧毁飞船
- 飞船日志已完全实现！包括入口位置、传闻、替代文本等
- 提示现在更详细地说明了如何进行，并更清晰地表明它们打算教什么。
- 结局现在不那么模糊。
- 修复了各种拉伸或未对齐的纹理
- 本地太阳将被强制将其光照半径设置为2500米（有人已经修复了它，因为这不是我的错？太糟糕了！贴片解决方案仍然保留！）

releases.name: Head Tracking for Outer Wilds v1.0.0
releases.body:
Initial release of Head Tracking for Outer Wilds.

### Features

- **OpenTrack Integration** - Receive head tracking data via UDP (port 5252)
- **Multiple Input Methods** - Works with phone, webcam, Tobii eye tracker, TrackIR, and any other OpenTrack-supported device
- **Full 6DOF Control** - Yaw, pitch, and roll camera rotation
- **Configurable Sensitivity** - Per-axis sensitivity settings for yaw, pitch, and roll
- **Smart Behavior** - Automatically reduces or disables head tracking during:
  - Dialogue scenes (when game controls camera)
  - Model ship flight (prevents camera lock-ups)
  - Signalscope zoom (for precise aiming)
- **Visual Fixes** - Proper handling of:
  - Map markers and UI elements
  - Reticle positioning
  - Flashlight direction
  - Quantum object visibility
  - Dark Bramble fog lights
- **Hotkeys**
  - F8: Re-center view
  - F9: Toggle head tracking on/off

releases.name: Version 1.0.0
releases.body: Outer Wilds is a game loosely based on real-world astronomy and orbital physics, but as anyone who has taken a high school physics class could tell you, the game is clearly not scientifically accurate at all. A black hole that doesn't spaghettify you? Trees that produce infinite oxygen? Sand passing back and forth between two planets? These are just a few of the many scientifically inaccurate things in the game. This mod removes all of the planets that are scientifically inaccurate, leaving only the ones that are scientifically accurate. The result is a much more realistic and scientifically accurate Outer Wilds experience.
releases.bodyZh: 星际拓荒是一款基于现实世界天文学和轨道物理学的游戏，但正如任何上过高中物理课的人都能告诉你的，游戏显然一点也不科学。一个不会把你拉成意大利面状的黑洞？能产生无限氧气的树木？在两个行星之间来回流动的沙子？这只是游戏中许多不科学之处的几个例子。这个模组移除了所有不科学的行星，只保留了那些科学的行星。结果是体验到一个更加真实和科学的星际拓荒。

- Interactables no longer require you to look away from them to reuse them
- Once you start the mod, you no longer have to re-perform the sequence to start it on future sessions. This is unfortunately not retroactive and you will need to start the mod at least once with this update.
- Added incompatibilities:
  - Time Saver: Skips the very important splash and a certain cutscene
  - Alter Time: Somehow causes a bug that causes the player to become giant
  - Global Screen Space Reflections: Causes a shader issue
- Marshmallows are now timeless
